title: Learned Pattern
description: Planned. A candidate or accepted unit of self-learned knowledge produced by the Observe/Extract/Candidate stages of the self-learning loop (workstream W3). Nothing in this schema is written automatically to a skill, rule or memory entry; only `keryx learn accept` followed by the existing `applyLearningProposal`/rule-writer path may cause a record here to affect durable content, and only after human consent (status transition candidate -> accepted).

id.description: Stable slug. Deterministic function of domain + normalized trigger text, not a random id, so the same observed pattern reinforces the same record instead of creating a duplicate.

trigger.description: The condition under which the pattern applies, in the project's own words. Free text, bounded; never generalized past what the evidence actually shows.

action.description: The recommended behavior when the trigger holds. Free text, bounded.

domain.description: Coarse category used for clustering and routing to a graduation target (W1/W2).

scope.description: project: visible only inside the originating project. user: promoted candidate visible across the user's projects (never written automatically; see promotion rule). A `scope: user` record still carries `status: candidate` until a human accepts it at that scope.

project.description: Identity of the originating project, used for the >=2-projects promotion count and for refusing cross-project writes.

identity.description: sha256 of the normalized git remote URL (credentials and query string stripped, trailing `.git` and slash removed, lowercased) when the project has a remote. When no remote exists, the identity falls back to a sha256 of the resolved, absolute worktree root path, and `identityKind` records which case applies.

displayName.description: Optional human-readable label (repo name or directory basename) for review UIs only; never used for identity comparison or deduplication.

confidence.description: Numeric confidence in [0,1], maintained only by the deterministic update formula in W3-self-learning.md (Numeric confidence model). Never set directly to an arbitrary value by an extractor; a new candidate starts at its extractor's fixed seed value.

confidenceLevel.description: Derived, not authored: the enum bucket existing consumers (skill-changelog provenance, review-note memory entries) expect. low: confidence < 0.5. medium: 0.5 <= confidence < 0.8. high: confidence >= 0.8. Recomputed whenever confidence changes; never edited independently of it.

status.description: candidate: extracted, not yet reviewed. accepted: a human ran `keryx learn accept`; still requires a separate apply/graduate step to touch a skill, rule or memory entry. rejected: a human ran `keryx learn reject`; kept for dedup so the same observation does not re-surface immediately. superseded: replaced by a newer record (a new id, derived from the changed action text) after reinforcement or contradiction crossed a boundary that changed the action text. expired: TTL elapsed with no human decision.

supersededBy.description: id of the record that replaced this one. Required non-null when status is superseded; null otherwise.

evidence.description: Every reinforcement and contradiction that touched this record's confidence. A record with an empty array cannot exist; an extracted pattern always has at least one observation behind it.

sourceType.description: Same vocabulary as `LearningSourceType` in src/gdskills/learn.ts, extended with hook-sourced observation kinds.

sourceRef.description: Path (relative to the project root) to the observation JSONL line, review-learning source file, health report, or memory entry that produced this evidence item. Never a raw quoted snippet of the source text.

weight.description: Contribution to the confidence update, before the deterministic formula's own scaling. Defaults to 1.0 (a single observation) when absent. Bounded at 1.5, the ceiling documented in W3-self-learning.md's Numeric confidence model for the strongest deterministic signal (a failing-to-passing test pair); no signal may claim more certainty than that.

reviewerProfile.description: Present only for domain: review-conventions records sourced from configured reviewers' comments (the reviewer-profile learning path). Null for every other domain.

reviewerId.description: Opaque per-project identifier for the configured comment author (e.g. a hash of the login), never the literal login or display name, matching the no-attribution guardrail carried over from the existing learned-review consumer skill.

generalizedFrom.description: Count of distinct source comments generalized into this record's trigger/action text.

redaction.description: Result of the mandatory security check-output pass over trigger/action/evidence text before this record could reach status candidate.

scanned.description: Always true for a stored record: a non-`true` scan result means the record was refused before it could reach this store, per `findings`' own description below.

findings.description: Category names only (e.g. "secret", "prompt-injection"), never the matched text. A non-empty array means the record was refused before reaching this store; this field exists for the audit trail of a refusal, not for a record that carries the flagged content.

graduation.description: Set once a cluster containing this record produced a skill/agent/rule proposal via the W1/W2 creators. Null until then.

extractor.description: Name of the deterministic signal or capability that produced the first evidence item, e.g. "repeated-correction", "reverted-edit", "failing-to-passing-test", "reviewer-comment", "health-regression", or a model-backed extractor id.

ttl.description: TTL bookkeeping for a candidate that has not been reviewed. Absent once status leaves candidate.
